title: Roveia case-study deck
description: Full-bleed media cards with 24px corners and the client's name (40px) and story at the bottom-left over a darkening gradient. On desktop each card is nearly a window high and sticks at the top, so the next slides up over it, growing from 90% to full size; a blue 'read the story' pill appears in the middle on hover.
notes: desktop: one window per card (sticky stack); phones: 360px cards in a column
one media slot per card; empty slots are dark surfaces
the original's pill follows the cursor; this one sits in the middle of the card
name: roveia-cases
